en: Hand-colored vintage postcard showing a hilltop complex with a large, pale castle-like building with a red roof and a small tower, surrounded by dense greenery and smaller village houses with tiled and thatched roofs in the foreground. In the background to the right, a tall church tower rises above the trees. The lower part of the card is mostly blank for writing, with red printed German text indicating a greeting from Taubenheim and the printer's details.
